verdict.rationale: Antigravity ships a Python Agent SDK and a CLI, so an interactive API reference is a fair axis for this product. However, the evidence documents no interactive API reference and no runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and llms.txt and markdown docs are static documentation, not an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
